overview: Pull the enchantments off an item and into a book, at a lectern. Server-side only: a vanilla lectern and a vanilla book hand back a vanilla enchanted book, so players need nothing installed.

1.1.1: Mod Menu's Donate button leads to sponsoring the author on GitHub. Nothing in play changes.
1.1.0: Split an enchanted book at a lectern: hold a book with several enchantments against a blank book and the top one comes off onto a book of its own.
A book carrying a curse does not split.
Items stripped at a lectern can be enchanted at the enchanting table again.
An item an earlier version stripped is set right by right-clicking any lectern with it.
1.0.2: A mod menu icon you can read at listing size.
1.0.1: Reading an item on an empty lectern says what each enchantment does in plain English.
Not just how near the ceiling its level is.
1.0.0: The step vanilla is missing between the grindstone and the anvil.
Put a blank book and quill on a lectern and right-click it with an enchanted item.
The item comes back clean, and a book carrying its enchantments pops off.
The price is a book and quill, no levels.
Curses stay put, the prior-work penalty is cleared, and everything moves at once.
